title: The city activity score counts upcoming public events, so an events-led city earns a city page
detail: density_by_city() (the facts behind the /discover/cities density gate) counted circles, residents and listings but no events, so a city whose activity was mostly events (standalone events above all, the follow-up LIVE-916 named) scored 0 and never got a page. Migration 20270346008800 drops and re-creates it with one new column, upcoming_events, counted with EXACTLY the public_events city and gates of 20270346008700 (Circle city else event city; public, published, not cancelled, upcoming, not removed, not demo, Space wall; hide_address events count by city), and adds event cities to the key set so an events-only city returns a row. Same language, STABLE, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path; grants re-stated service_role only with the by-name revoke (ADR-959). lib/analytics/density.ts adds an additive events term weighted GROWING_SCORE/100 = 0.40, full at EVENTS_FULL = 8 upcoming events (5 points each, about six residents on the demand term), so events alone reach exactly 'growing' (a city page) and never 'ready': with no circle members the score caps at READY_SCORE - 1, keeping the existing no-circles-caps-at-growing rule. A row without the column reads as 0 events, so the code is safe before the migration applies. CITY_PAGE_MIN_SCORE unchanged. Tests: lib/analytics/density.test.ts and pgTAP supabase/tests/density_by_city_upcoming_events.test.sql. Migration applies at merge (owner). Verify after applying: select city, upcoming_events from public.density_by_city() where upcoming_events > 0 order by 2 desc;

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='supabase/migrations/';const f=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(n=>/^\\d{14}_.*\\.sql$/.test(n)&&/function public\\.density_by_city\\(/i.test(fs.readFileSync(d+n,'utf8'))).sort().pop();const s=fs.readFileSync(d+f,'utf8');if(!/upcoming_events\\s+bigint/i.test(s)||!/coalesce\\(\\s*nullif\\(\\s*trim\\(\\s*c\\.city\\s*\\)\\s*,\\s*''\\s*\\)\\s*,\\s*nullif\\(\\s*trim\\(\\s*e\\.city\\s*\\)/i.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-917: the latest density_by_city ('+f+') does not count upcoming public events by the public_events city');process.exit(1)}const t=fs.readFileSync('lib/analytics/density.ts','utf8');if(!/W_EVENTS\\s*\\*\\s*clamp01\\(\\s*events/.test(t)){console.error('LIVE-917: scorePlace ignores upcoming_events');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync('supabase/tests/density_by_city_upcoming_events.test.sql')){console.error('LIVE-917: the pgTAP guard is missing');process.exit(1)}"
